name: bedpostx
summary: Fits FSL BedpostX (GPU version, FSL 6.0.1) multi-fibre ball-and-stick models to preprocessed DWI within a brain mask, producing the sample distributions needed for probabilistic tractography.
description: Runs bedpostx_gpu on the DWI, bvals, bvecs and nodif brain mask to estimate up to nf fibre orientations per voxel with MCMC sampling. Use it before FSL probtrackx. Needs preprocessed (eddy/motion corrected) DWI and a brain mask in the same space, and a GPU node.

inputs.description: A 4D series of data volumes. This will include diffusion-weighted volumes and volume(s) with no diffusion weighting.
3D binary brain mask volume derived from running bet on nodif (i.e. on a volume with no diffusion weighting). Created using FSL Brain Extraction (BET) on DWI brainlife/app-FSLBET

outputs.description: This folder contains the entire set of folders and files outputted by the FSL BedpostX  process

parameters.description: Maximum number of fibres to fit in each voxel.
ARD fudge factor (integer) controlling automatic relevance determination of extra fibres.
